    "pce_stabilised": null,

    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "This paper is a review summarizing deposition methods for perovskite films, carrier transport layers, and electrodes for the top perovskite cell of perovskite/Si tandem solar cells.", "anchor": "This review paper summarizes the deposition methods used to fabricate perovskite films, carrier transport layers (CTLs), and electrodes for the top perovskite cell of perovskite/Si TSCs.", "evidence_type": "inference"},
      {"text": "The review includes a cost comparison between solution-processed and vacuum-based deposition methods.", "anchor": "Furthermore, a cost comparison between solution‐processed and vacuum‐based methods is presented.", "evidence_type": "inference"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 1,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25.54, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the resulting TFBZ‐based 1D/3D hybrid PSCs achieve a power conversion efficiency of 25.54%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Two new 1D perovskite single crystals were synthesized using benzamidinium and trifluoromethyl benzamidinium as spacer cations.", "anchor": "Here, we report the synthesis of two new types of 1D perovskite single crystals, (BZ) 2 Pb 1.5 I 4 , (TFBZ)PbI 3 , using benzamidinium (BZ) and (trifluoromethyl) benzamidinium (TFBZ) as spacer cations.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The trifluoromethyl groups in TFBZ create extensive hydrogen-bond networks and a high dipole moment that strengthen interaction with the inorganic skeleton.", "anchor": "Our analysis reveals that the trifluoromethyl groups in TFBZ contribute to extensive hydrogen‐bond networks and confer a high dipole moment.", "evidence_type": "inference"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 2,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 21.65, "unit": "%", "anchor": "The superior performance of MQPPO-incorporated devices was reflected in their power conversion efficiency (PCE), achieving 21.65% under 1 sun illumination."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": {"value": 1440, "unit": "h", "anchor": "maintaining over 80% of their initial efficiency after 1440 h"},
    "claims": [
      {"text": "A quinoxaline-based high-dipole material MQPPO was introduced as a cathode interlayer for p-i-n perovskite solar cells.", "anchor": "In this study, we introduce a quinoxaline-based high-dipole material (MQPPO) as a novel cathode interlayer (CIL) for p-i-n structures.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "MQPPO-based devices maintained over 80% of initial efficiency after 1440 hours.", "anchor": "Additionally, MQPPO-based PSCs demonstrated exceptional long-term stability, maintaining over 80% of their initial efficiency after 1440 h.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 3,
    "architecture": "n-i-p",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25.29, "unit": "%", "anchor": "PSCs incorporating 1 set a new benchmark with an efficiency of 25.29%."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Hydrophobic fluorinated phenyl groups were introduced onto the tetraphenylethene structure to make electron transport interfacial materials.", "anchor": "To address these issues, we have introduced hydrophobic fluorinated phenyl groups onto the TPE structure, electron transport interfacial materials, such as 1,1,2,2‐tetrakis(2',3',4',5',6'‐pentafluoro‐[1,1'‐biphenyl]‐4‐yl)ethene ( TFP‐TPE, 1 )", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Photoluminescence measurements showed enhanced electron extraction and transport with the TFP-TPE interlayer.", "anchor": "Steady‐state and time‐resolved photoluminescence measurements reveal enhanced electron extraction and transport properties in PSCs incorporating perfluorophenyl‐substituted TPE 1 as an interlayer.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 4,
    "architecture": "n-i-p",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 22.2, "unit": "%", "anchor": "PSCs achieve power conversion efficiencies of 22.2% (≈0.12 cm 2 minicells) and 21.7% (≈1.6 cm 2 minimodules, active area: 1.41 cm 2 ), respectively"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": {"value": 0.12, "unit": "cm2", "anchor": "22.2% (≈0.12 cm 2 minicells)"},
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "TEA-TFSI was newly synthesized as a spontaneous perovskite passivator for n-i-p PSCs using PTAA as the HTM.", "anchor": "2‐thiophene‐ethyl‐ammonium‐TFSI (TEA‐TFSI) is newly synthesized and verified as a spontaneous perovskite passivator for n–i–p PSCs employing thermally stable poly[bis(4‐phenyl)(2,4,6‐trimethylphenyl)amine] (PTAA) as the HTM.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "TEA cations passivate both A-site and X-site defects via ammonium and thiophene moieties.", "anchor": "where TEA cations are adsorbed at both A ‐ and X ‐site defects via ammonium and thiophene moieties, respectively, overcoming the single‐site limitation of RA‐TFSIs.", "evidence_type": "inference"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 5,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25.92, "unit": "%", "anchor": "Consequently, PSCs incorporating TFMP achieve a champion power conversion efficiency of 25.92% and exhibit markedly improved operational durability."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Pyridine derivatives DMAP and TFMP were introduced to regulate the Li-TFSI environment and improve spiro-OMeTAD doping.", "anchor": "In this work, two commercially available pyridine derivatives, 4‐(dimethylamino)pyridine (DMAP) and 4‐(trifluoromethyl)pyridine (TFMP), are introduced to regulate the Li + –TFSI – environment and improve the doping behavior of spiro‐OMeTAD.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "TFMP-treated devices retained over 91% of initial efficiency after 1000 h of MPPT at 1-sun illumination.", "anchor": "Notably, under continuous maximum power point tracking (MPPT) at 1‐sun illumination, TFMP‐treated devices retained over 91% of their initial efficiency after 1000 h.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 6,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 23.5, "unit": "%", "anchor": "achieving a champion power conversion efficiency of 23.5% and retaining 20.6% at 1.0 cm 2"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": {"value": 1.0, "unit": "cm2", "anchor": "retaining 20.6% at 1.0 cm 2"},
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "PDVB14 is a PTAA-based random copolymer incorporating planar divinylbenzene units made by Buchwald-Hartwig C-N cross-coupling.", "anchor": "Here, we introduce PDVB14, a PTAA‐based random copolymer incorporating planar divinylbenzene (DVB) units through compositionally reliable Buchwald–Hartwig C–N cross‐coupling.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Dopant-distribution mapping showed uniform Li profiles across 6 x 6 cm2 films.", "anchor": "Dopant‐distribution mapping reveals highly uniform Li profiles across 6 × 6 cm 2 films, demonstrating excellent compatibility with large‐area solution processing.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 7,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": null,
    "pce_certified": {"value": 26.35, "unit": "%", "anchor": "The resulting PSCs deliver a certified power conversion efficiency of 26.35%"},
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Tripodal phosphonic acid molecules were used to regulate co-deposition dynamics of the perovskite absorber and hole transport layer.", "anchor": "Herein, we demonstrate a multidentate molecular anchoring strategy leveraging tripodal phosphonic acid molecules to regulate the co‐deposition dynamics of the perovskite absorber and hole transport layer.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices retained 82% of initial performance after 1000 h thermal testing at 85C and 86% after 1000 h of MPPT.", "anchor": "retaining 82% of their initial performance after 1000 h of thermal stability test (85°C) and 86% after 1000 h of maximum power point tracking.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 8,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.73, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the MeS‐BPADCP based device achieved a remarkable power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 26.73%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": "ISOS-T-3",
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "An integrated molecular design restructured the SAM MeS-BPADCP with bisphosphonate anchoring units, aromatic linkers, and methylthio terminal groups.", "anchor": "incorporating bisphosphonate anchoring units, aromatic linker moieties, and methylthio (MeS‐) terminal groups.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The device sustained 94.2% of initial efficiency after 1000 h of continuous one-sun operation.", "anchor": "while sustaining 94.2% of its initial efficiency after continuous operation under one‐sun illumination for 1000 h.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The device retained 93.3% of initial PCE after 240 thermal cycles between -40C and 85C under ISOS-T-3.", "anchor": "retaining 93.3% of its initial PCE after 240 cycles within a temperature range of −40°C to 85°C (ISOS‐T‐3 protocol).", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 9,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": "((FA0.95Cs0.05)PbI3)0.975(MAPbBr3)0.025",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25.53, "unit": "%", "anchor": "boosted the device PCE from 23.55% to 25.53% and enables 94.8% retention after 1142 h of continuous one‐sun illumination"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "A pancake-like Au12Ag30 nanocluster with halide and fluorothiolate ligands was designed and synthesized to boost PSC efficiency and durability.", "anchor": "Here, we report the design and synthesis of the pancake‐like [Au 12 Ag 30 (SPh 3,5− (CF 3 ) 2 ) 10 Br 20 ] 6− (Au 12 Ag 30 ) NC, and its use to boost the power conversion efficiency (PCE) and durability of perovskite solar cells.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Adding 0.5 mg/mL of the cluster to the perovskite film raised PCE from 23.55% to 25.53% with 94.8% retention after 1142 h.", "anchor": "Introducing 0.5 mg/mL of this cluster into ((FA 0.95 Cs 0.05 )PbI 3 ) 0.975 (MAPbBr 3 ) 0.025 perovskite films boosted the device PCE from 23.55% to 25.53%", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 10,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25.57, "unit": "%", "anchor": "ambient‐printed devices achieve champion power conversion efficiencies of 25.57% for 0.09 cm 2 , 23.98% for 1.04 cm 2 , and 22.98% in 5 × 5 cm 2 mini‐modules"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": {"value": 0.09, "unit": "cm2", "anchor": "champion power conversion efficiencies of 25.57% for 0.09 cm 2"},
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Aromatic formamidine ligands enable a dual-functionalized bonding mechanism coordinating with both inorganic framework and organic cations during ambient printing.", "anchor": "Herein, we unveil a dual‐functionalized bonding (DFB) mechanism enabled by aromatic formamidine ligands that concurrently coordinate with both the inorganic framework and organic cations during ambient printing.", "evidence_type": "inference"},
      {"text": "Ambient-printed 5 x 5 cm2 mini-modules achieved 22.98% efficiency.", "anchor": "22.98% in 5 × 5 cm 2 mini‐modules.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Optimized devices retained over 90% of initial performance after 1,000 h of continuous operation.", "anchor": "The optimized devices retain over 90% of their initial performance after 1,000 h of continuous operation.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 11,
    "architecture": "n-i-p",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25.47, "unit": "%", "anchor": "PyTPA-10C, featuring an even-carbon decyl chain as a dopant-free HTMs in n-i-p structured PSCs, achieves a champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 25.47%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Three pyrene-based dopant-free HTMs were synthesized by covalently linking two pyrene-triphenylamine precursor units.", "anchor": "Herein, three pyrene-based HTMs (PyTPA-9C, PyTPA-10C, and PyTPA-13C) were synthesized by covalently linking two pyrene-triphenylamine precursor units", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The odd-even effect of the alkyl spacer modulates molecular conformation and electronic structure.", "anchor": "Critically, the odd-even effect of the alkyl spacer plays a significant role in modulating the molecular conformation and electronic structure.", "evidence_type": "inference"}
    ]
  }
]
